events.title: 즈리 보야현에서 태어나다
events.description: 즈리 보야현에서 태어났다. 아버지가 어느 관리 집안의 양자로 들어가 있던 터라 어릴 적 이름은 주방량이었다.
events.description_en: He was born in Boye County, Zhili. Since his father had been adopted into an official's family, his childhood name was Zhu Bangliang.

events.title: 아버지가 청군을 따라 관외로 떠나다
events.title_en: His father fled beyond the pass with Qing forces
events.description: 명나라가 무너지던 무렵 양가와 사이가 틀어진 아버지가 청군을 따라 관외로 떠났다. 이후 소식이 끊겼다.
events.description_en: As the Ming dynasty collapsed, his father, at odds with the adoptive family, fled beyond the pass with the Qing army. No word came from him afterward.

events.title: 어머니가 개가하고 양조부모 밑에서 자라다
events.title_en: His mother remarried and he was raised by his adoptive grandparents
events.description: 아버지의 소식이 끊긴 지 여러 해가 지나자 어머니가 개가했다. 그는 양조부모와 함께 남아 자랐다.
events.description_en: After years without word from his father, his mother remarried. He stayed behind and was raised by his adoptive grandparents.

events.title: 주자가례대로 상을 치르다 죽을 고비를 넘기다
events.title_en: He nearly died observing mourning rites by Zhu Xi's manual
events.description: 양조모가 죽자 주자가례를 그대로 따라 사흘을 굶고 아침저녁으로 곡을 하며 몸을 상했다. 이 경험이 송명 이학에 등을 돌리는 계기가 되었다.
events.description_en: When his adoptive grandmother died, he followed Zhu Xi's mourning manual to the letter, fasting for three days and wailing morning and night until his health broke. This experience turned him against Song-Ming Neo-Confucianism.

events.title: 농사짓고 의술을 익혀 생계를 잇다
events.title_en: He farmed and studied medicine to support his family
events.description: 가난한 살림을 꾸리려고 밭을 갈고 정원을 가꾸는 한편 의술도 익혔다. 책상머리 공부보다 몸으로 부딪는 실학을 몸소 겪은 시기였다.
events.description_en: To support his poor household he worked the fields and tended gardens while also studying medicine. This period gave him firsthand experience of practical learning over book-bound study.

events.title: 쉰 살에 관외로 아버지를 찾아 떠나다
events.title_en: At fifty he set out beyond the pass to find his father
events.description: 쉰 살이 되어서야 관외로 떠나 아버지의 행방을 뒤졌다. 성경에 방을 붙여 아버지를 아는 사람을 수소문했다.
events.description_en: At the age of fifty he finally traveled beyond the pass to search for his father. He posted notices in Shengjing asking for anyone who knew him.

events.title: 이복 누이를 만나 아버지 무덤을 찾아내다
events.title_en: He met his half-sister and located his father's grave
events.description: 방을 보고 찾아온 이복 누이 인교를 만나 서로 붙잡고 울었다. 누이의 안내로 아버지 무덤을 찾아 절하고, 위패를 손수 모셔 고향으로 돌아왔다.
events.description_en: His half-sister Yinjiao, who had seen his notice, came forward, and the two wept in each other's arms. She led him to their father's grave, where he paid his respects, then carried the memorial tablet home himself.

events.title: 제자 이공과 안이학파를 이루다
events.title_en: He and his disciple Li Gong formed the Yan-Li school
events.description: 제자 이공을 만나 자신의 사상을 이어갈 동반자를 얻었다. 두 사람의 이름을 딴 안이학파가 이렇게 자리를 잡았다.
events.description_en: He gained in his disciple Li Gong a partner who would carry his thought forward. The school that came to bear both their names, the Yan-Li school, took shape through this bond.

events.title: 장난서원 원장이 되어 6재 교육을 펴다
events.title_en: He headed Zhangnan Academy and taught its six halls
events.description: 예순두 살에 장난서원을 맡아 강당에 거문고와 활, 화살, 산가지를 늘어놓고 예·악·사·서·수를 몸으로 익히게 했다. 병법·농사·치수 같은 실용 학문도 함께 가르쳤다.
events.description_en: At sixty-two he took charge of Zhangnan Academy, filling its hall with zithers, bows, arrows, and counting rods so students would learn ritual, music, archery, writing, and mathematics through practice. He taught practical subjects too, from military strategy to farming and water control.

events.title: 보야현에서 세상을 떠나다
events.description: 고향 보야현에서 숨을 거두었다. 일흔 살이었다.
events.description_en: He died in his hometown of Boye County. He was seventy.
